messages:
maria_sec: quick recap — detection on Friday: small spike in failed KMS decrypts from service account 'redwood-worker'. alerted by rule kms-decrypt-fail-high. incident resolved, but need followups.
jon_sre: saw it. containment: rotated the per-runner SA key, rolled back a bad deploy, and throttled traffic to that pool. short-lived impact, no customer data suspected.
liam_eng: root cause appears to be a config drift: an older autoscaler image had env var pointing at old KMS key. when key policy changed, decrypts failed.
hannah_pm: thanks. can we codify this into the post-incident checklist and schedule a tabletop?
kevin_infosec: +1 tabletop. proposed agenda: detection tuning, RBAC gating for key access, audit log retention, KMS rotation runbook validation. owners for each item.
maria_sec: proposed owners: detections -> kevin_infosec, rbac review -> liam_eng, kms/runbook -> jon_sre, audit queries -> auditsvc (will hand off to SRE). can we add backlog tickets and due dates?
jon_sre: will own kms/runbook. short TODOs: 1) add explicit KMS key aliasing check in deployment CI (owner: jon_sre, due: 2026-05-12) 2) create playbook step to verify key policy post-rollout (owner: kevin_infosec, due: 2026-05-05) 3) RBAC: deny-list legacy service accounts for decryption (owner: liam_eng, due: 2026-05-08).
liam_eng: adding RBAC change note: propose policy fragment to deny decrypt on key resource for service account pattern: `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` scoped to `projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/old-*`.
liam_eng: snippet to propose: ```json
{"bindings": [{"role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter","members": ["serviceAccount:legacy-runner@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"],"condition": {"title": "deny-old-keys","expression": "resource.name.startsWith('projects/_/locations/_/keyRings/_/cryptoKeys/old-')"}}] }
```
kevin_infosec: looks good, but let's avoid condition complexity; prefer explicit deny-binding in org policy. I'll draft the policy and show dovetail with IAM review.
hannah_pm: tabletop date? availability next week Wed/Thu. prefer Wed.
maria_sec: wed 2026-05-06 @ 10:00 PT works for me. I'll book a 60m session and invite eng, sre, infra, product.
jon_sre: I'll add runbook checklist items to infra-runbook.md: include steps: `verify KMS alias`, `run decrypt smoke test`, `rotate key with staged alias switch`, `rollback alias on failure`.
auditsvc: audit log queries attached: `resource.type=\"k8s_cluster\" protoPayload.methodName=\"Decrypt\" protoPayload.status.code=5` — retention note: increase decrypt-failure logs to 90d for now.
maria_sec: final ask: create JIRA epic 'KMS-RBAC-Postmortem' and link tickets. owners & due dates above. I'll follow up once jira is created. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-04-30 18:22 UTC: rollback applied to service/runner v2.1.3 -> v2.1.2.
kevin_infosec: thanks everyone. action items summarized in thread. I'll draft tabletop agenda and policy PR by EOD tomorrow.
